name: SPT-CL J2337-3822 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J2337-3822, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj23373822-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, picked from a catalog of more than 500 clusters found through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. Hubble surveyed clusters like this one to study how they bend light and how the giant galaxies at their hearts grow through mergers.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ2337-3822 is a target of Hubble program 16017, a snapshot survey of SPT galaxy clusters
The program's clusters were selected from an SPT catalog of more than 500 clusters identified via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
The imaging is used to study strong lensing and the growth of brightest cluster galaxies through mergers
The clusters in the sample are massive
